messages:
Nora: Heads up 1: hiring a 0.5 FTE contractor (20 hrs/wk) who starts 11/01. They asked if any accrued sick at contract end can be rolled into a floating holiday or paid out. Need exact phrasing for SOW.

Olivia (People Ops): Short: contractors don't automatically get sick payout or rollover unless it's written in the SOW. We can add a one-off transitional sick clause but it must be explicit and approved.

Diego (Hiring): Is there a minimum accrual threshold that triggers payout? e.g., if they accrue >= 3 days.

Olivia (People Ops): No automatic threshold. If you want to offer it as a recruiting sweetener, propose the exact amount (e.g., "up to 3 days of unused sick paid as a one-time stipend"), and we'll route to Legal + Finance.

Priya (Manager): Budget ok for up to 3 days. Operational question: if we grant a floating holiday instead of cash, does payroll need any special code?

Lina (Payroll): Floating-day grants for contractors are manual entries in Horizon and accepted only for W-2s. For contractors we can only process cash adjustments on the final invoice, not calendar-time grants. If you want floating day, we must make the hire a W-2 or hire as a temp employee. Otherwise, cash on final invoice is the only option. Cutoff for December invoice adjustments: 12/10 COB.

Nora: So SOW text should be: `Unused sick (if any) may be considered for a one-time cash stipend up to X days, subject to People Ops and Finance approval and invoice cutoff.` OK?

Olivia (People Ops): Works. Add: `For contractors only; if hired as W-2, separate policy applies.` We'll need manager email approval attached when you submit the exception request.

Diego: Another small ask 1: we have a team member requesting to swap the company-observed 12/24 holiday to 12/27 because of travel. Policy for holiday swaps?

Olivia (People Ops): Holiday swap rules: generally we honor swaps if operationally feasible and requested in advance. Managers approve swaps; People Ops must record the change. Swaps are limited to the same calendar week unless there's a documented business need.

Priya (Manager): Team can cover 12/24 but only if the swap is logged. I'll approve if they file the request in the people-ops flow and confirm backup for critical duties on 12/18-12/22 (release prep).

Lina (Payroll): Payroll note: holiday swaps for employees are entered as a date override. We need the request before 12/01 to update year-end calendars. Otherwise we treat as unpaid time or a discretionary floating day after approval.

Nora: Good to know. I'll update SOW language on the contractor item and add the exception path. For the holiday swap I'll tell the IC to file the swap request and provide backup coverage note.

people-ops-bot: New exception ticket created: #HR-2031-501 1: attach manager approval and SOW draft. Triage ETA: 2 business days.

Olivia (People Ops): Thanks everyone. Nora	1		once you drop the SOW clause in the ticket, ping me. If we go cash stipend, Finance will need the budget code and final invoice date to approve.
